summary.tldr: Changes Canada Labour Code bereavement leave, giving longer time to take leave after a child’s death and adding leave for stillbirths and miscarriages.
what_it_does: Extends bereavement leave for the death of a child under 18, or a child eligible for the Canada caregiver credit, to up to 8 weeks after the funeral, burial, or memorial service.
Creates a right to up to 8 weeks of leave after a stillbirth experienced by an employee or their spouse or common-law partner.
Creates a right to 3 days of leave after a miscarriage experienced by an employee or their spouse or common-law partner.
Keeps general bereavement leave at up to 10 days for the death of an immediate family member, with leave taken up to 6 weeks after the funeral, burial, or memorial service.
summary.background: The bill amends the Canada Labour Code. It adds new rules for leave after the death of a child and for the loss of an unborn child.
